newsitem.title: UK: Safeway weak after low-end results.
newsitem.headline: Safeway weak after low-end results.

text.p: Shares in Safeway Plc edged lower in early trading on Thursday after the supermarkets operator posted a seven percent rise in first-half pretax profit, towards the low end of analyst expectations.
The stock was down 1p at 370, after on Wednesday touching a year's intraday high of 373p.
Pre-tax profit rose to 228.2 million stg from 213.7 million stg a year before and the company said it would pay out an interim dividend of 4.4p.
Analysts had expected pre-tax profits of between 228 million and 231 million stg and a dividend of between 4.3p and 4.6p per share.
